mapper.insert: insert into notifications ( receiver_user_id, actor_user_id, type, post_id, content, read_flag ) values ( #{receiverUserId}, #{actorUserId}, #{type}, #{postId}, #{content}, 0 )
mapper.select: select n.id, n.actor_user_id, u.username as actor_username, n.type, n.post_id, n.content, n.read_flag, n.created_at from notifications n left join users u on u.id = n.actor_user_id where n.receiver_user_id = #{receiverUserId} order by n.created_at desc, n.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
